## 简体中文

- 隧道配置新增 WS / WSS 协议选择，可连接 OpenWrt 的 WS 服务端。
- 保存和重新编辑时保留所选协议，切换协议时保留已填写的地址与端口；新增实例默认使用 WSS。
- 后端接受 WS 和 WSS 地址，WSS 连接继续启用证书校验。
- 已通过现有隧道测试、UI 入口测试、隧道 crate 的 Clippy、仓库 lint 和类型检查；真实 OpenWrt 连通性待更新后验证。

## English

- Add a WS / WSS protocol selector to tunnel settings, allowing connections to OpenWrt WS servers.
- Preserve the selected protocol when saving and reopening settings, and retain the address and port when switching protocols. New instances default to WSS.
- Accept both WS and WSS server URLs while retaining certificate verification for WSS connections.
- Passed existing tunnel tests, the UI entry test, tunnel crate Clippy, repository lint, and type checks. Live OpenWrt connectivity remains to be verified after updating.
